question: The smallest executable retrieval/counter-authority falsification benchmark of this lane (minimal_ca_benchmark.py + mapping_free_recall_falsifier.py, both ACCEPTED, both PRODUCT_FALSIFIED on the packet-of-record v3 exact bytes) still carries one open audit caveat: its dedicated provenance test suite tests/evaluation/test_minimal_ca_benchmark.py fails 3 of 11 tests solely because state/evaluation.json lost its minimal_ca_benchmark provenance block between accepted cycles 39806933576 (commit 664f4a32, block present with re-hashed pins) and the accepted tip. Is the failure purely state-metadata drift - with every frozen file, test file, instrument byte and rubric unchanged - so that restoring the block with values re-derived by re-hash (never re-tuned) turns the dedicated suite green and closes the audit's 'infrastructure issue only' caveat without weakening a single test?
why_this_cycle_not_a_rerun: The accepted mapping-free falsification of the v3 bytes (runs 39852758814 and 39854748616, both gate PASS) is discharged evidence and is NOT re-measured on identical bytes. The ordered items (1)(2)(5) of the v63 question remain NOT_TRIGGERED and (3)(4) STANDING_OK on the unchanged product mount fe219a19 (adjudicated by accepted cycle 39861821734 and re-pinned here). What is NOT discharged is the open test-suite defect the audit of 39854748616 itself disclosed: 'minimal_ca_benchmark test shim SHIM_FAIL (7/3/1) - infrastructure issue only'. With real pytest the same file fails exactly 3 tests, all KeyError 'minimal_ca_benchmark' against state/evaluation.json, while the 8 offline provenance tests (frozen hypothesis re-hash, freeze-commit ordering, frozen-bar pins, committed-record conformity, instrument-sha disclosure, evidence-ref hygiene, output defaults) pass. Repairing that metadata drift is new durable delta; re-running the falsifier on identical bytes would not be.
hypothesis: G1-G6 hold with controls C1-C3: (G1) PRE-REPAIR, the dedicated suite run against the committed pre-repair state fails exactly the 3 state-block tests (test_hypothesis_rehash_matches_state_pin, test_state_freeze_commit_is_where_the_hypothesis_landed, test_state_pytest_claim_names_this_dedicated_test) with KeyError 'minimal_ca_benchmark' and passes the other 8; (G2) the restored minimal_ca_benchmark block carries only re-derived values: hypothesis_sha256 equals the live re-hash of evaluation/MINIMAL_CA_BENCHMARK_HYPOTHESIS_V1.json (pinned f0c7711c71e94d7b7303f5fa3a61b444d67bee6d3bbd7f0708ed13ff6ffc8072), freeze_commit 6892f9f0 is the commit that first added that hypothesis and its blob re-hashes to the same digest, and the pytest claim cites tests/evaluation/test_minimal_ca_benchmark.py and keeps the 'PRE-REPAIR CLAIM WAS FALSE' disclosure verbatim beside the replacement claim; (G3) POST-REPAIR, the dedicated suite passes with zero failures under the measurement environment recorded in the machine record; (G4) every frozen input the suite and this repair rely on re-hashes byte-identical before and after (frozen hypothesis, its freeze record, evaluation/minimal_ca_benchmark.py, RULES_LABEL 4457e971..., RULES_GEOMETRY a7452748..., VERDICT_CONTRACT b9cdb894...); (G5) the two sibling falsification suites reuse-green under the same interpreter (tests/evaluation/test_minimal_retrieval_ca_benchmark.py and tests/evaluation/test_mapping_free_recall_falsifier.py, zero failures), closing the audit's no-pytest-shim caveat with a real measurement; (G6) the stand-ready posture of the v63 ordered items is re-adjudicated unchanged: accepted product mount head fe219a19, product/query/adversarial_retrieval.py sha 9764a37e..., items (1)(2)(5) NOT_TRIGGERED and (3)(4) STANDING_OK.

controls.C1_negative_control_pre_repair_state_sti: running the dedicated suite with LEXMACHINA_STATE_OVERRIDE pointed at an unmodified copy of the committed pre-repair state still fails exactly the 3 state-block tests - proving the tests bite and that the repair, not a test edit, flipped them.
controls.C2_planted_wrong_hypothesis_sha_is_detec: a copy of the repaired state with one hex character flipped in minimal_ca_benchmark.hypothesis_sha256 fails test_hypothesis_rehash_matches_state_pin under the override.
controls.C3_broken_evidence_ref_is_detected: a copy of the state with one evidence_ref replaced by a nonexistent path fails test_state_evidence_refs_resolve_and_count_matches under the override.

baseline: Accepted evaluation tip a7e3565f (accept cycle 39861821734, gate PASS) with its committed state/evaluation.json (no minimal_ca_benchmark key; measured 8 passed / 3 failed under pytest 9.1.1 on this host before any edit) and the audit caveat of run 39854748616's gate file (minimal_ca_benchmark test shim SHIM_FAIL 7/3/1, infrastructure issue only). Historical block values re-derived, not copied blindly: the same pins are independently re-hashed from the frozen hypothesis file and from git show 6892f9f0.
non_weakening_contract: No test file is edited. No frozen hypothesis, freeze record, rubric, bar, verdict contract, instrument or benchmark record is edited, regenerated, re-tuned or re-derived. The only content edit is the surgical restoration of the minimal_ca_benchmark provenance block inside state/evaluation.json (a lane-owned, per-cycle-rewritten state file), plus this cycle's normal state reconciliation fields. The falsification verdict PRODUCT_FALSIFIED on the v3 bytes, both DO-NOT-SERVE orders, the fail-closed admission posture and the REPORTED-ONLY frozen absolute bars are untouched and re-asserted.
population: state/evaluation.json (pre- and post-repair), tests/evaluation/test_minimal_ca_benchmark.py, tests/evaluation/test_minimal_retrieval_ca_benchmark.py, tests/evaluation/test_mapping_free_recall_falsifier.py, evaluation/MINIMAL_CA_BENCHMARK_HYPOTHESIS_V1.json, evaluation/MINIMAL_CA_BENCHMARK_FREEZE_RECORD_V1.json, evaluation/minimal_ca_benchmark.py, evaluation/frozen_bars/{RULES_LABEL,RULES_GEOMETRY,VERDICT_CONTRACT}.json, the accepted product mount at /tmp/lex_accepted/product (head fe219a19), and git history for freeze-commit 6892f9f0. No packet, bundle, retrieval or live-model execution; no network.
claim_ceiling: This instrument establishes exactly one thing: that the dedicated provenance test suite of the accepted minimal-CA falsification benchmark was failing only because of lost state metadata, and that restoring that metadata by re-derived pins turns the suite green with no test, frozen-file or threshold change. It is NOT a new retrieval, counter-authority, label, geometry, live-answer or serve measurement; it does NOT re-run the v3 falsification claim (that evidence stands from 39852758814/39854748616); it does NOT move or meet either frozen bar; it lifts no DO-NOT-SERVE order; it does NOT certify any packet; it keeps human_gate_ready, machine_gate_ready, packet_admitted and ready_for_owner_session false; it runs no obsolete universal-174k benchmark.

exit_code_contract.2: ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS (wrong run id or freeze-first digest drift)

freeze_first_disclosure: This hypothesis and its freeze record are committed BEFORE the claim-bearing instrument executes. The instrument re-hashes the hypothesis file, its freeze record and its own bytes at start and exits 2 if any drifted.
network_policy: zero network at execution: committed files, local git and the product mount only.
determinism: SHA-256 re-hash, exact string/JSON comparison, pytest execution; no RNG, threshold or model.
